Mirror the B300 Agg TP2 launches from https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4647 (verified in https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40895671658) into the MiniMax-M3.1 AgentX explorer: `--schedule-policy shortest-prefill-first` with `--prefill-decode-interval 16` at c40–c56, and 32 at c48.
